en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small European town in a valley, photographed from a field in the foreground. A wooden fence and scattered trees lead toward a compact cluster of houses with steep, tiled roofs. A church with a tall baroque-style tower and onion-shaped dome stands prominently on the right. Behind the town are low, forested hills and open fields; on a distant hilltop to the left a faint outline of a castle or fortification is visible. The top-center area of the image has a damaged or overexposed patch. There is no visible printed caption or handwriting.
